label: Triennial third-party assessment / annual self-assessment
text: Level 2: Triennial third-party assessment for critical national security information, annual self-assessment for other information

label: Annual affirmation
text: Self-assessments can be submitted on behalf of an institution through the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) by authorized representatives associated with an organization's CAGE code. While full reassessments occur every three years, affirmations of the self-assessment must occur annually to avoid a lapse in the assessment.
frequency: annual affirmation; full reassessment every three years

label: Third-party assessor requirement
text: Third-party assessments must be performed by a CMMC certified third party assessor (C3PAO) or Defense Contract Management Agency's Defense Industrial Base Cybersecurity Assessment Center (DIBCAC), depending on the prescribed CMMC level.

label: Conditional CMMC status
text: Under DFARS 204.7502-1 and DFARS 252-204-7021(c)(1), a DoD contractor or subcontractor can be awarded a contract with a “conditional CMMC status”. Conditional status is a temporary authorization to proceed under contract while completing any remaining corrective actions identified during an assessment and documented in an approved Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M). Conditional CMMC status only applies to CMMC Level 2 and Level 3 assessments and may last up to 180 days from the date it is granted. Failure to successfully close-out all remaining POA&M items within the conditional period results in non-compliance.

label: Threshold award requirement
text: CMMC certification is a threshold award requirement. An offeror lacking the required status is ineligible for new awards or exercise of option periods for existing contracts.
